build_chamfer_3D_CUDA_extension: build the chamfer_3D CUDA extension module by running python setup.py install in the chamfer3D directory
install_chamfer_3D_with_pip: install the chamfer_3D CUDA extension package by running pip install in the chamfer3D directory
use_chamfer_3DDist_module: use the chamfer_3DDist nn.Module to compute bidirectional Chamfer distance between two 3D point cloud tensors on GPU
use_chamfer_3DFunction_autograd: use the chamfer_3DFunction autograd Function to compute forward and backward Chamfer distance with gradients for two point clouds
review_CUDAExtension_setup: review the setup.py CUDAExtension configuration that compiles chamfer_cuda.cpp and chamfer3D.cu into the chamfer_3D module
